issuer: the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
note: The DMV's licensing fees page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class C original application fee, $46, and the regular ID card's, $40 (no fee from 62, $11 reduced). Its renewal page says an original licence expires on the fifth birthday after the application, so it is kept as 5 years; the ID card page says a standard card is valid for six birthdates (kept as 6) and that an ID card is issued at any age, so the card has no age. The handbook says a licence issued under 18 is provisional, with restrictions, so a full licence is held from 18 (a provisional one from 16). Not held: the senior and reduced-fee cards, a limited-term licence that ends with the holder's identity document, and the REAL ID marking, which costs nothing more.

sources.title: California DMV, Licensing Fees
sources.said: Class C Application – Original – Renewal – Adding a motorcycle license (Class M1/M2) Fee $46 ... Regular ID card Application – Original – Renewal – Replacement (lost or stolen) – Change DL/ID Information – Emancipated minor Fee $40

sources.title: California DMV, Driver's License Renewal
sources.said: Every original DL expires on the applicant’s 5th birthday following the application date.

sources.title: California DMV, Identification (ID) Cards
sources.said: In California, DMV may issue an ID card to a person of any age. ... Standard ID cards are valid for six birthdates after the application date.

sources.title: California Driver's Handbook, Getting an Instruction Permit and Driver's License
sources.said: When you are under 18 years old, your driver’s license will have the word provisional.
